title: Switch AI engine from OpenRouter to Google Gemini

requirements.text: Replace the existing OpenRouter-based AI text chat implementation in `frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts` with Google Gemini API (model: `gemini-1.5-flash` or `gemini-pro`). The engine should send user messages to the Gemini REST endpoint (`https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-flash:generateContent`) using the user's stored Gemini API key. Preserve existing message history handling, error handling, and the helper functions for API key storage/retrieval.

quotes: Switch to Google Gemini (which has more generous free limits than OpenAI)?

acceptanceCriteria: Sending a text message in the AI Guru chat triggers a request to the Gemini API endpoint, not OpenRouter.
The response from Gemini is displayed correctly in the chat UI.
If no API key is stored, the user is prompted to enter their Gemini API key.
The stored API key is used for all subsequent requests.

requirements.text: Update the API key configuration UI in `frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx` to reference Google Gemini instead of OpenRouter. Change all labels, placeholder text, and help copy to say 'Gemini API Key' and direct users to `https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey` to obtain a free key. Remove any OpenRouter-specific instructions.

quotes: Switch to Google Gemini (which has more generous free limits than OpenAI)?

acceptanceCriteria: The API key input panel shows 'Google Gemini API Key' as the label.
A help link or instruction text points users to https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey.
No mention of OpenRouter remains in the UI.

requirements.text: Update `frontend/.env.example` and any relevant comments or documentation strings in the codebase to reflect that the app now uses the Google Gemini API instead of OpenRouter/OpenAI. Note that users obtain a free Gemini API key from Google AI Studio.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example references Gemini, not OpenRouter or OpenAI.
No stale references to OpenRouter API keys remain in comments or documentation strings.

constraints: Image generation should continue to use Pollinations.ai (free, no key required) — do not route image generation through Gemini.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not add any backend changes — API key storage and AI calls remain entirely client-side.
nonGoals: Embedding a shared/hardcoded API key for all users — each user must supply their own Gemini key.
Switching the image generation provider away from Pollinations.ai.
Any changes to the backend Motoko actor.
